contracts.half_witness: forall n : Int, n % 2 = 0 -> exists m : Int, n = m + m
contracts.forward: forall n : Int, Even n -> n % 2 = 0
contracts.backward: forall n : Int, n % 2 = 0 -> Even n

proof_route: forward destructures the Even witness and applies double_mod_zero; backward is the half_witness contract at the definition of Even. No official modulo theorem or simp dependency is used.
next_on_accept: Construct double_mod_zero from clean modulo recursion and half_witness from the already native Euclidean decomposition at divisor two.
limitations: The arithmetic leaf contracts remain obligations after residual qualification.
